decisions.rationale: Accepted as a shared Markdown-derivation defect: diff lines and definition-list rows ran together in the generated companions. Fixed in the shared tooling by https://github.com/JesterCharles/pep-technology-content/pull/22 and applied by regenerating the module's Markdown and PDFs with the merged tooling at 4da6419; no hand edits.
